prompt: Can you explain what 'kiasu' means? I keep seeing it but I don't really get it.

assertions.text: Explanation gives the Hokkien etymology (kia = fear, su = lose)
Response uses Singlish particles throughout (not just at the very end)
Response includes at least one concrete real-life example of kiasu behaviour
Response has a self-deprecating or affectionate tone about Singaporeans, not clinical
